capabilities: Analyze dated notes for mood, energy, connection, and intensity
Show mood history dashboard with chart ranges and daily summaries
Support optional cloud analysis through multiple API providers
Run offline with local fallback and retry rules
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5 or later; cloud analysis is optional and uses provider API keys, stored in Obsidian secret storage on 1.11.4 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to summarize mood and related signals across dated notes over time.
